items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Joe Louis had been drafted in... He used to train at the Brewster Center down from where I lived.

ctx.x: No, not her this time! It wasn't her. It was me this time. But I'll get around to that. But it was really, really great times in Detroit during that period.

Joe Louis had been drafted in... He used to train at the Brewster Center down from where I lived. I used to live on Erskine and Bovian(?), and the Brewster Center was on Hastings one block below Erskine. So it was only one big street, about a block-and-a-half away. That's where Sugar Ray came up, over there in the boxing thing... You know, he had... When he first went in the Army, I used to see him sitting on the steps at the Norwood Hotel down on the (?). He'd sit out on the steps, and he had on his G.I. uniform…
